name: comp-224

frames.best_why: The list is open with all three plans, each paired with its grey description, and Pro Plan ticked.

tagline: A plan dropdown that shows a one-line reason under each name.
summary: A labelled dropdown of plans whose open rows pair each plan name with a short grey description, while the closed trigger keeps only the name. The chosen plan ends in a tick.
appearance: A long white field label sits above a compact rounded trigger reading Pro Plan with a chevron. Opened, a dark panel shows three rows, each a plan name followed by a small grey blurb, the selected one ticked at its right edge.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger drops the list over the label; hovering a row highlights it, and choosing one closes the panel, leaving just the plan name in the trigger. The clip settles on Enterprise Plan.
demo_content: Standard Plan / Ideal for individuals; Pro Plan / For professional users; Enterprise Plan / Built for large teams
search_phrases: dropdown with a description under each option
pick a plan from a list with details
two line options inside a dropdown
choose a plan with a short blurb
use_when: When each choice needs a one-line explanation, such as plans or tiers, and the closed field must stay short.
avoid_when: The open list sits over the field label and hides most of it, so the label must be short or repeated elsewhere.
customise: The three plans and their blurbs are written in the file; edit the text or add rows there. The trigger drops descriptions through a class, and the menu spacing is set in the same file.
weight_why: Three text rows in a popup with one short open animation.

a11y.note: The label is tied to the trigger and each option keeps its description in the text, so both are read aloud; the open animation ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The open list covers the field label, leaving only its first and last letters showing.
The on-screen label is a demo phrase, Select with description and right indicator, not a real field name.
polish_why: Tidy two-line options, but the open list lands over the label and hides it.
title: Plan Description Select
